column1: # Curated subset of INV-03.b (forbidden synonyms) that is safe to check by
# blind case-insensitive text search across published pages.
# Format: <glossary term><TAB><forbidden phrase>
# This list is deliberately NOT the full set of forbidden synonyms enumerated
# in features/03-manual-do-metodo/epics/01-modelo-de-conteudo-e-linguagem-ubiqua/plan.md
# section 5. A phrase is included here only when it has no legitimate,
# independent meaning anywhere else in this site's English content. Phrases
# left out (e.g. "README", "task", "feature", "user story", "best practices",
# "guidelines", "source of truth", "monorepo") are real forbidden synonyms
# too, but each one also names something this site legitimately talks about
# elsewhere. "monorepo" is the clearest case: the source corpus's own
# definition of Workspace explains the concept *by contrast* with monorepos
# ("no generic monorepos, shielding the blast radius"), so any faithful page
# describing the isolation pillar will legitimately use the word. A blind
# text match on any of these would fail pages that use the word correctly,
# which is a false failure — not the false pass this checker exists to
# prevent, but still a broken gate. Those are enforced editorially instead:
# see plan.md section 2, INV-03.a.
Workspace
Feature/Epic
Domain Enabler
Domain Enabler
Spec
Consequential Code
